answer: A fresh key is a nebula, diffuse and weightless, because voting power in an agent economy comes only from quorum-matched grading verdicts a key has sealed on-ledger. Every seal is re-checked against consensus, so standing cannot be minted or handed to a clone. Trust opens slowly like a lotus, one honest epoch at a time; a thousand fakes find only bare dune, since each identity must repay the full grading labor itself. The Sybil bill scales linearly with the number of clones.
